query:
SELECT id, entry_key, title, authors, year FROM bibliography_entries 
WHERE authors LIKE '%Arctander%' 
   OR authors LIKE '%Merleau%' 
   OR authors LIKE '%Böhme%' 
   OR authors LIKE '%Carles%'
   OR authors LIKE '%Roudnitska%'
   OR authors LIKE '%Ellena%'
   OR authors LIKE '%Tolaas%'
   OR authors LIKE '%Guenther%'
   OR authors LIKE '%Bauer%';
